results.title: Meloni and Frederiksen Push Tougher EU Migration Policy
results.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen have reaffirmed their opposition to what they described as “uncontrolled immigration,” calling for tougher measures against illegal migration and the creation of return centers in countries outside Europe. In a joint statement published Monday, the two leaders said that, despite coming from different political backgrounds and representing countries with different geographic realities, they share a commitment to defending Europe and its common values. Meloni and Frederiksen are currently the only women serving as prime ministers of European Union governments. ...

results.title: Manipur CM Khemchand Singh chairs Unified Command security meet
results.description: Guwahati: In a major transfer to evaluate and strengthen the State’s safety, Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh chaired the Mixed Headquarters (Unified Command) safety assembly on the Chief Minister’s Secretariat, Imphal. Throughout the assembly, the Chief Minister reviewed the prevailing legislation and order scenario throughout the state.
